description: This file defines the GrainCollectionOptionsValidator class, which implements configuration validation logic for grain collection options in Orleans. It checks various parameters such as collection quantum, collection age, and memory pressure settings to ensure they are within valid ranges.

classes.name: GrainCollectionOptionsValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating the configuration options related to grain collection in Orleans.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation on the grain collection options, checking collection quantum, age, and class-specific collection ages.

methods.name: ValidateHighMemoryPressureSettings
methods.description: Validates memory pressure related settings such as polling period, memory usage limit, and target percentages.
